name: ROUND BOX BROOCH, 700–900

The four oval compartments on the top show beasts with round eyes, open jaws, claw feet, and intricately entwined bodies. Known as a box brooch because it was used as a container for small objects, it would have been worn by a Viking woman on the island of Gotland to secure her shawl at the collar.

name: VIRGIN OF GUADALUPE SACRED HEART WITH CROWN REGULAR PRICE
note:
Dimensions in inches (Width x Height x Depth): 18 x 27 x 3.5

Joaquin Garnica is a talented woodworker and painter from Michoacán Mexico. First he hand shapes his pieces, then sands and lastly he paints an original painting on them. His pieces often depict the Virgin of Guadalupe, sacred hearts and flowers among other images. He is unusual in his use of oil paints instead of acrylics which give his artwork a glow that seems to come from within. 

Every piece is an original work of art and can vary in color and size.

name: VENUS AS A BOY
note:
The accompanying music video for "Venus as a Boy" was directed by English director Sophie Muller and features Björk in a kitchen, fondling and cooking eggs. The usage of eggs was inspired by the singer's favorite book, Story of the Eye by Georges Bataille, a novella which deals with the bizarre sexual perversions of a pair of teenagers. At one point in the book, a girl, Simone, uses boiled eggs for sexual stimulation.

The story of the egg comes as Björk explains:

She [Sophie Muller] kept going on about it being fried. I was saying, 'No way is that book about a fried egg! I'm sorry. Poached? Okay. Boiled? Okay. Raw? Okay. But not fried.' [And a fried egg is unsuitable because......?] Because it's too hard. It's rough and it's greasy. It should be about being sort of liquidy and wet and soft and open...

She gave Muller a copy of Story of the Eye a couple of days before they filmed but did not insist that she read it. Muller did not have the time. After recording the video and then reading the book, Muller admitted to Björk that "Fried was the wrong egg!"

name: STANDING FEMALE FIGURE, ANDEAN CERAMIC (PROBABLY PERUVIAN CENTRAL/SOUTH COAST)
note: Painted ceramic standing female figure with hands on hips, a red slip body, and cream and black stepped-fret face paint, zigzag chest bands and banded thighs, shown on a metal stand.

name: CUSTOM-PAINTED FULL-FACE HELMET, CREAM AND BLACK FLAME PATTERN WITH GOLD PINSTRIPE (MODEL UNCONFIRMED, LIKELY GRINGO)
note: A retro full-face motorcycle helmet with a cream base, black flame-style graphics and gold pinstriping, with a DOT marking on the rear.

name: LA CHIMÈRE GOWN, HAUTE COUTURE AUTUMN/WINTER 1997-98
note: Couture gown with a gold articulated armoured corset, iridescent hand-painted scales set with crystals, feathers and horsehair, and a feathered headpiece. Made with corsetier Mr. Pearl and artist Jean-Jacques Urcun for the 'Les Chimères' collection.

name: POPULAR DEFENCE MILITIA TRAINING, KHARTOUM, 1993 (?)
note: Colour photograph of a girl in a white headscarf and sunglasses aiming an AK-pattern rifle, with a line of similarly dressed women behind her. Photographer, date and location are unconfirmed.

name: MARILYN (SADDLE PIGEON), FROM THE NEW YORK PIGEON
note: A rescued New York street pigeon whose wings fold together into a heart shape. The bird's name and wing description are from a 2018 book of Garn's pigeon portraits, and this image is not confirmed as one of its published photos.
credit: All photos From 'The New York Pigeon' by Andrew Garn, published by powerHouse Books.

name: SONIC & KNUCKLES, 1994
note: Airbrush-style promotional illustration of the Sonic (blue) and Knuckles (red) faces inside a yellow-rimmed black oval, with a partial "PRESENTS" line at the top, apparently from a 1994 Sega ad or box art for Sonic & Knuckles. Exact medium, size and collection are unconfirmed.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Digital or painted black silhouette of a figure in a wide-brimmed flat-crowned hat and coat, with two red eyes, against a streaked grey and white background. It resembles the 'Hat Man' shadow-figure motif from sleep-paralysis folklore. I couldn't find the artist or title, because a text search can't match an image like this.

name: EIGHT-POINTED STAR, MESOPOTAMIAN (STAR OF ISHTAR / INANNA) MOTIF
note: High-contrast ink-style reproduction of an eight-pointed star with a raised central disc and spiral, in the style of the Ishtar/Inanna star symbol of ancient Mesopotamia.

name: BLUE AND WHITE NECKLACE
note: Three solid pieces of loom-woven glass bead work (size 10 beads) joined by bead strings, in dark blue, white, green and light blue, with a dark blue bead fringe. The image is a photograph on page 32 of an unidentified bead-weaving book, which gives materials and a counted design for working it.

name: KANAGA MASK
note: Carved wood face mask with a double-cross superstructure, white and dark pigment, and iron or leather fittings on the arms. The form is a Dogon kanaga, worn mainly at the dama funerary rite.

name: FALL 2024 COUTURE (?)
note: Runway-style look: a translucent, frosted skull-shaped head mask with cut-out eyes and fanged teeth, worn with a multi-strand white pearl collar, pearl drop earrings, and white sculpted shoulder pieces over a black garment.

name: TANKER TRUCK REAR GRAPHIC, "C22 CUM TRUCK – BACK OFF! WE AINT HAULIN MILK!"
note: Snapshot of the rear of a fuel tanker (placard 1203, gasoline) with a custom decal. The decal shows a Yosemite Sam-style cartoon character in a feathered headdress holding two hatchets.

name: TYPHOON SILVER BOOTS
note: Knee-high boot with a non-removable ruched metallic overlayer and a lug sole. Rombaut's site lists the upper as 63% PU and 37% PL and the sole as 100% TPU, though some retailers give different materials.

name: GOURD
note: A dried gourd (hyōtan-type double gourd) with a glossy red-brown lacquered or varnished surface, bound with tan braided cord and a red silk tassel, shown on a flat metal base.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Photograph of a mud-plastered interior with incised concentric geometric patterns on the floor and walls, with a man in white kneeling at the centre; the location and date are not confirmed. A small "ATA" logo appears in the lower-right corner.

name: CARVED WOODEN DOOR PANEL (MGBO EZI TYPE)
note: Carved wooden panel, a long plank with symmetrical shallow-relief figures and incised geometric borders (diamond and zigzag patterns).

name: UNKNOWN
note: Painted terracotta head of a bearded man with curly hair, shown in a museum case beside a pale blue glass jug. The wall label appears to read as Roman-period Egypt, but it is too blurred in the photo to confirm the title, date or collection.

name: NEBUCHADNEZZAR'S DREAM OF THE STATUE AND THE STONE CUT OUT OF THE MOUNTAIN (DANIEL 2)
note: Illustration of the golden-headed statue from Daniel 2, with a stone rolling down from a glowing mountain.

maker: WATCH TOWER BIBLE AND TRACT SOCIETY OF PENNSYLVANIA
name: IT HAS COME TO PASS! (ILLUSTRATION, REVELATION 16:17)
note: Full-page painted illustration on page 233 of the book Revelation—Its Grand Climax At Hand!, showing the seventh bowl of wrath (Revelation 16:17) poured from the sky onto a collapsing city. The publisher's caption reads "Those motivated by Satan's polluted 'air' must suffer the execution of Jehovah's righteous judgments."
credit: Watch Tower Bible and Tract Society of Pennsylvania (publisher); artist not credited in the source

name: UNKNOWN
note: Painted illustration of a family walking across a green, flower-filled meadow away from a burning town, with a numbered tag ("7") in the lower right.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Illustrated scene in an airbrushed, early-1980s religious-tract style. A smiling couple and two other groups walk over cracked paving slabs, with a lit church and a stormy orange sky behind them.

name: PINK CHECK COTTON SHIRT WITH DRAPED SHOULDER
note: Pink cotton check shirt with a collarless neckline, front button placket and a draped fabric panel across one shoulder, worn with black wide-leg trousers and black flat shoes.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Black oversized zip-trimmed hooded sweatshirt with ruched sleeves, shown in a full look with an asymmetric black skirt, a black cap with ear flaps, a small round bag and black lace-up flats.

name: GREY SWEAT SKIRT, ASYMMETRIC HANDKERCHIEF HEM
note: Grey marl cotton-jersey midi skirt with an elasticated drawstring waist, distressed hem and a pointed handkerchief hem that shows the cream reverse side. It is styled with cream ribbed socks and white and taupe sneakers with a blue logo. The maker is a best guess from the hem label and the sneakers.

name: CEREMONIAL AXE WITH FEMALE FIGURE (PROBABLY YORUBA, NIGERIA)
note: Carved wood and forged iron blade on a stand, with a kneeling female figure holding her breasts and a scarified headdress.

name: CEREMONIAL AXE (KIBIKI / KASOLWA) WITH STACKED FIGURES
note: Carved wooden handle with three stacked figural heads and a crescent iron blade, leather-bound butt, mounted on a wooden stand.

name: HORNED FACE MASK (N'TOMO OR NDOMO TYPE)
note: Carved wood face mask with a pair of horns and ridged side arches, probably West African (Mali or Burkina Faso).

name: UNKNOWN
note: A painted relief panel showing a standing red bull with a white head, blue-rimmed eyes and black horns, on a raised plinth, set in a rectangular frame. Medium and date are not confirmed.

name: UNKNOWN
note: from africa fashion exhibition at the victoria an albert museum in london.

name: NIGHTCLUBBING ALBUM COVER, 1981
note: Created during their work on Jones's transition from disco to new wave, the image played with themes of masculinity, dignity, and avant-garde fashion.

name: VICTORIAN PINK TOPAZ CROSS PENDANT
note: Cross pendant with step-cut pink stones and old-cut diamonds in closed-back settings, silver tops on gold, with a gold bale.
credit: A La Vieille Russie, New York

maker: ALTAMURA MAN (NEANDERTHAL, LAMALUNGA CAVE, ALTAMURA, PUGLIA, ITALY)
name: ALTAMURA MAN, SKULL ENCRUSTED IN CALCITE
note: Neanderthal skeleton discovered in 1993 by CARS speleologists. Its bones are covered in calcite formations, and it has been dated to roughly 130,000–170,000 years old. It was left in situ in the cave.

name: PUFF BRACELET, 2021
note: sterling silver

name: DEVANT DE CORSAGE, 1908
note: A bow-shaped stomacher of diamonds with sapphire accents, with a central cluster and long fringed and drop pendants.

name: ANIMAL FLOWER CAVE, BARBADOS
note: Photograph of a natural limestone cave interior, with a rough, weathered ceiling and a floor of wet rock and pebbles. It shows no artwork, garment or manufactured object, and no identifiable site.

name: CRAB
note: Photograph of a small spotted crab on a wet, algae-covered rock surface in dim light.

name: CUT GLASS PERFUME BOTTLE WITH DISC STOPPER
note: Smoke-gray cut-glass perfume bottle with a large round fan-cut stopper and a star-cut center.

maker: EDO ARTISTS, KINGDOM OF BENIN (IGUN ERONMWON BRASS-CASTING GUILD)
name: PLAQUE WITH WARRIOR CHIEF, 16TH–17TH CENTURY
note: Cast brass (lost-wax) relief plaque from the Oba's palace at Benin City, Nigeria. It shows a chief with a coral-beaded helmet and collar, a leopard-tooth necklace and a ceremonial eben sword, with a crescent and rosettes on the ground. The plaque is broken at the edges.

name: BAT, 2006
note: X-ray photograph of a fruit bat with wings spread, made by Veasey from a bat bought online; listed as a C-type print, 1189 x 1189mm, edition of 5, from 2006.

name: SLEEPING SWAN
note: Black-and-white photograph of a swan asleep on water with its head tucked under its wing, with a stone ledge along the bottom edge.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Crinkled, crushed-metallic jacket in pink, black and bronze tones, with a stand collar, a tie front and gathered long sleeves.

name: TRIANGULAR DIATOM
note: Microscope image of a triangular diatom frustule with a patterned silica lattice, in false or interference colour on black.

name: ANT PUPAE (MACRO PHOTOGRAPH)
note: Focus-stacked macro or photomicrograph of two ant pupae on black, one pigmented orange-tan and one pale white, with cocoon-like cases below.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Digital illustration of an animal cell in a jewel-toned palette, with a nucleus, mitochondria, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi and vesicles shown on a black ground.

name: CHICKEN EMBRYO FIBROBLAST CELLS, FLUORESCENCE MICROGRAPH
note: Fluorescence micrograph of two cultured cells with red fibrous structures, blue cell edges and green nuclei on a black background.
credit: Michael W. Davidson and The Florida State University, Molecular Expressions Microscopy Primer, Fluorescence Digital Image Gallery

name: UNKNOWN
note: False-colour 3D rendering of a spiked, roughly symmetrical virus-like particle, coloured from red at the centre through yellow and green to blue at the spike tips, on a black background.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Digital 3D render of a virus-like particle with green protein-ribbon spikes and a blue inner core on a black background.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Freestanding assemblage of purple-painted metal with scrolled wrought-iron elements, small figurines, a white angel and a crescent moon, on white-painted legs; shown in a corner of a gallery. Size, year and collection are not visible in the photo.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Black-outlined grey graffiti wall piece painted on a concrete or stucco wall beside an asphalt lot, with a palm tree in the background. The lettering is not legible enough to read a word, and no signature or date is visible.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Red-lit replica cave with sculpted stalactites, stalagmites and flowstone walls, possibly a museum or exhibit set piece. Maker, date and venue could not be confirmed.

name: UNKNOWN
note: A night snapshot of a silver passenger car with heavy front-end collision damage. The front bumper is torn off, the wheel and suspension are exposed, and debris is on the asphalt. It looks like a vehicle-accident photo, not an artwork, design piece or fashion item, so I couldn't tie it to a maker or catalogue entry. I didn't run a web search, because nothing in the image points to a source to confirm.

name: CARVED STONE CARTOUCHE ROUNDEL
note: A carved pale stone cartouche with acanthus scrolls and rosettes frames a round opening with a green-painted disc and iron bars, set into a tan speckled brick facade. The building, date and maker could not be identified.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Black-and-white photograph of boys at a long wooden workbench in a workshop, several holding white shaped frames or mirror-frame forms, shown in a gold-painted wood frame with a tan mat.

name: PARIS MÉTRO ENTRANCE RAILING (GARDE-CORPS), C. 1900
note: Green-painted cast-iron balustrade panel in the Art Nouveau style of Guimard's Métropolitain entrances, which were cast iron set in concrete. The specific station and exact date of this panel are not confirmed.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Black-painted wrought iron post with scrolled and leaf-like arms, fixed into a concrete plinth at a wall corner. Maker, date and collection are not identifiable from the photo.

name: CYBERSM, 1993
note: Best guess from the partly cropped caption beside the image ("St… / Cy… / 19… / Co…"). It reads as Stahl Stenslie's CyberSM, a 1993–94 telepresence touch project made with Kirk Woolford. The image is a page from a book of two digitally rendered bronze-toned torso views, and I could not match these exact images to the work.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Black-and-white photograph, printed on a book page, of a performance in a domestic room: taut cords run across the space, and one shirtless man stands among them while a second man faces away from the camera. The source book's text is partly visible but I could not identify the work.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Colour photograph reproduced on a printed book page, showing a figure seated in a chair wearing a red fur-trimmed jacket, red leather trousers and knee-high red platform boots, with white face makeup. Year and photographer are not established.

name: CYNICAL BLUE, JOVIAL BROWN, DOGTOWN
note: Oil on board in a dark wood frame with a silver liner, shown in a private-sales display. The wall label is too small to read reliably, and I could not confirm a date, dimensions, or collection.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Painted interior surface with a red ground, white floral arabesques, blue and dark green medallions and raised gilded rosettes; the style suggests Ottoman palace decoration, but I could not confirm the building or date.

name: SANDY WEAVES BEDCOVER
note: Grey wave-and-trefoil jacquard on an off-white satin ground, shown close up. The listing I found describes a Pearl Grey Frette bedcover with a wave jacquard motif, but no source I found shows this particular motif.

name: UNKNOWN
note: Photographed floor surface with a repeating checkerboard of brown ring-and-oval motifs on a cream ground, in an op-art style. Likely vinyl or tile, but the material, maker and date could not be confirmed.

name: CARVED WOOD PANEL WITH STAR-AND-POLYGON LATTICE
note: Carved wood panel with a geometric star-and-polygon lattice and floral openwork cartouches, in a style associated with Central Asian (Uzbek) Islamic woodwork. Maker, date, and origin could not be confirmed.

name: BASILICA CISTERN (YEREBATAN SARNICI), ISTANBUL, C. 532
note: Underground Byzantine water reservoir beneath Istanbul's old city, with 336 columns in 12 rows of 28 and brick vaulting, many columns reused from older structures. Built under Justinian I, around 532, and lit in red for visitors today.

name: THE BORDA GARDENS, CUERNAVACA, MEXICO, 1915
note: Oil on canvas, approximately 28 x 20 in (66.6 x 50.8 cm), per a partly legible wall label reading "Painted in 1915"; the label is cropped and blurry, so the title and date are unverified.

name: THE FOUNTAINS, 1926
note: Oil on canvas, 36 1/8 × 32 in. (91.8 × 81.3 cm), 1926. A yellow celestial disk behind a central orb, with streams of water flowing around it.
credit: Gift of Joan H. Tisch (by exchange), object number 179.2023, The Museum of Modern Art, New York

name: UNKNOWN
note: Backlit translucent alabaster vessel in an egg form with a domed lid and a wave-carved lower band, shown on a black plinth in a dark gallery space. Maker, year and collection could not be confirmed.

name: NEW IDOLS, DAZED AUTUMN 2026 (VOL. VI) COVER, COMME DES GARÇONS A/W26
note: Magazine cover of DAZED Autumn 2026 (Vol. VI), UK £7.99, showing Alaina Rae in a pink Comme des Garçons A/W26 draped jacket and dress with Comme des Garçons × John Fluevog leather boots.
credit: Photography Paolo Roversi, Styling Imruh Asha; DAZED
